title: Club Aqua 201
subtitle: Modern Elegance on the Marina
description:
Recently completed in 2024 in the heart of Puerto Aventuras, this contemporary residence redefines coastal elegance. Designed to offer absolute privacy and modern comfort, it represents a rare opportunity to acquire a new asset on the Riviera Maya. The immaculate architecture integrates perfectly with the exclusive and secure environment of the marina.

Deploying 1410 sq ft of refinement, the interior layout celebrates natural light while protecting your privacy. The vast bay windows are equipped with anti-UV film with exterior mirror effect, creating a thermal and visual shield imperceptible from the outside. The living space revolves around a fully equipped kitchen with high-end finishes, opening onto three spacious bedrooms and two bathrooms with sleek design.

The experience extends through common areas conceived as a true private club. The property offers privileged access to a spectacular pool with marina views, relaxation areas with outdoor fireplaces, and boat slips. For friction-free logistics, this property includes a private storage space of 45 sq ft, as well as two parking spaces, one of which is in a secure underground level accessible by elevator.

Living within this prestigious address guarantees absolute peace of mind thanks to controlled access, 24/7 security, and reception service with exclusive lobby. A few steps from the crystal-clear waters of the Caribbean and the marina's boutiques, this recent development offers an exceptional investment opportunity or a sophisticated primary residence for lovers of boating and serenity.
